info.batch.details:
More details:
- Excel import must include Brand + Product Code columns
- Run smaller batches to isolate problematic products
- Watch per-row Status/Error for quick troubleshooting
info.batch.text: Use when you have many products. Add rows manually or import from Excel. Fix invalid rows until the status shows it's ready, then start the batch.
info.batch.title: Batch upload
info.descriptions.details:
More details:
- Save reusable HTML for all three product languages
- Use the source view if formatting looks off
- Reuse the same template name across individual and batch workflows
info.descriptions.text: Create and maintain reusable HTML templates for LT/EN/LV. The editor provides a visual view and HTML source; the saved result is HTML.
info.descriptions.title: Descriptions
info.extra.text:
If something doesn’t work as expected:
- Ensure you are logged in and the browser window is still open
- Navigate to Products and retry
- Refresh the page if a table/search looks stale
- Run smaller batches to isolate a problematic product
info.extra.title: Extra steps (advanced)
info.folders.details:
More details:
- Ensure you are on the Products list before scraping
- The preview shows the grouping before writing folders to disk
info.folders.text: Scrape product names from the current session and generate a local folder structure. Parent folder = text before the first '/'. You must choose a repository path each run.
info.folders.title: Build folder structure
info.history.details:
More details:
- Use the expand arrow on a history row to see extra details
- Export is useful for sharing failures with product codes
info.history.text: Use this to review what happened: success/failure, duration, images/features counts, and error messages. Export to Excel when needed.
info.history.title: History
info.login.details:
More details:
- If login fails, confirm credentials and try a different browser
- Keep the browser open; closing it ends the session
info.login.text: Choose your browser, enter your credentials, and sign in. After login, the app keeps using the same browser session for all automation.
info.login.title: Login
info.overview.details:
More details:
- Most screens reuse the same Selenium session after login
- Avoid clicking around in the admin panel while a batch is running
- If something looks stuck, check the browser window first
info.overview.note: Tip: Keep the browser window open while running uploads/scrapes.
info.overview.text: UltraBike Automation helps you upload products faster by reusing a logged-in browser session and automating repetitive steps.
info.overview.title: What this app does
info.safety.details:
More details:
- Don’t run two automations at the same time
- If a page looks inconsistent, refresh the browser and retry
info.safety.text: Don’t edit products manually in the same browser session while an automation task is running. Prefer short runs and verify results after completion.
info.safety.title: Good practices
info.settings.details:
More details:
- If downloads go to the wrong folder, update the path here
- Theme and language changes can be previewed before saving
- Browser count controls parallel batch processing
info.settings.text: Configure paths, appearance, browser behavior, and product-processing options. Settings are stored in the local database.
info.settings.title: Settings
info.title: Info
info.translations.details:
More details:
- Use Refresh after edits if you don’t see changes reflected
- Keep translations consistent across brands to avoid mismatches
info.translations.text: Manage term translations used by the automation (search, add, edit, delete). Refresh to pull the latest from the database.
info.translations.title: Translations
info.upload.details:
More details:
- Prefer UB- codes when possible
- If product isn’t found, use the retry prompt to re-enter the code
- Verify the saved product fields after completion
info.upload.text: Pick a brand, enter product code and/or URL, select a description template, and start upload. If a retry prompt appears, you can retry with the same or a new code.
info.upload.title: Upload
